title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
slides: Can Nectar's AI agent replace your influencer scout?
Built to automate creator discovery and outreach
It hunts niche creators big agencies overlook
You gain outreach time without losing human judgment
Test one campaign manually against the agent
thread_text:
1. Your Influencer Scout, Automated

Nectar's AI agent now discovers and contacts niche creators your agency probably misses. It targets the long tail, not just the big names.

2. The Long Tail Gets Hunted

Big agencies chase the same 1% of creators. This agent goes after the overlooked 99%, where engagement is higher and competition is thinner.

3. Outreach Without the Grind

You still make the final call, but the agent handles the busywork: finding, filtering, and first contact. That's hours back every week.

4. Judgment Still Wins

Automation doesn't mean autopilot. You keep the human filter for brand fit and authenticity, while the agent does the legwork.

5. Test Before You Trust

Take one real campaign and split it: run your manual process on half, the agent on the other. Compare results in a week. Does it save time without costing quality?
